skill.name: context-receipts
skill.description: Guides AI agents to emit privacy-safe receipts for context selection, tool hydration, retrieval, compaction, delegation, usage attribution, and boundary handoffs.
skill.summary: Create privacy-safe evidence of what enters, leaves, or stays outside an AI agent context.
skill.author: caioribeiroclw-pixel

security_audit.summary: All 49 static findings are false positives: README paths are fixed references, SKILL.md backticks are Markdown, and reconnaissance matches are audit prose. However, README.md instructs readers to execute four Node scripts outside the scanned skill package. Those scripts require separate review before use.

remediation.issue: The README invokes executable scripts outside the audited skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Include and audit the scripts within the package, pin a trusted source, or remove the commands. Warn users that external scripts require review.

5. **Boundary:** if a manager subagent or child agent was used, did raw child output return to the p

content.user_title: Audit Context Boundaries with Privacy-Safe Receipts
content.value_statement: Context-saving workflows often lack evidence about what crossed an agent boundary. This skill defines privacy-safe receipts for routing, loading, suppression, and audit gaps.
actual_capabilities: Defines receipt evidence for MCP discovery, tool search, definition hydration, tool calls, and runtime catalog changes.
Tracks selected, delivered, acknowledged, cited, suppressed, and missing context identifiers.
Documents delegation boundaries between parent agents, managers, subagents, and captured tool outputs.
Describes transaction evidence for context pruning, compaction, rollback, and protected state.
Provides JSON and JSONL event examples for common context-engineering workflows.
Uses hashes, counts, buckets, redaction flags, and audit gaps to reduce private-data exposure.
limitations: The skill provides Markdown guidance and does not automatically collect, store, or validate receipts.
Receipts prove boundary behavior and evidence coverage, not semantic correctness or tool relevance.
Implementations must supply trustworthy event data and enforce the stated privacy controls.
README fixture scripts are outside the scanned package and require separate security review.

use_cases.title: Audit MCP Tool Loading
use_cases.description: Validate which MCP tools were discovered, hydrated, activated, withheld, or called without exposing schemas, arguments, results, or prompts.

use_cases.title: Verify Retrieved Context Attention
use_cases.description: Confirm that required context was delivered, acknowledged before planning, and cited before edits while preserving content privacy.

use_cases.title: Review Context Budget Changes
use_cases.description: Trace pruning, compaction, rollback, usage attribution, and delegation to determine whether claimed context savings have supporting evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Receipt
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a privacy-safe receipt for [workflow]. Include stable IDs, counts, token buckets, redaction flags, and one explicit audit gap.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one context workflow

prompt_templates.title: Check Receipt Privacy
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [receipt] for raw prompts, schemas, arguments, results, secrets, customer names, and transcript text. Report every privacy violation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Privacy validation before storing a receipt

prompt_templates.title: Compare Tool Surfaces
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [before state] and [after state]. Produce a tool-surface receipt covering discovery, activation, blocking, redaction, and unresolved evidence gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Multi-Agent Boundary
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a receipt chain for [workflow]. Trace delegation, tool exposure, retrieval, compaction rollback, usage attribution, and raw-content boundary decisions.

output_examples.input: A Tool Search session starts with 84 deferred tools and hydrates one definition.
output: Startup loaded an index for 84 tools and no full schemas.
One definition was hydrated after search; 83 tools remained suppressed.
Arguments and results were redacted. Tool relevance remains unproven.

output_examples.input: A compaction request fails before context replacement.
output: Summary generation failed and no candidate summary was available.
The original context and deferred-tool registry were preserved.
No stale reminders replayed. Semantic quality was not evaluated.

output_examples.input: A retrieval workflow returns five chunks but loads only three into agent context.
output: Three retrieved chunks were loaded; two stale or duplicate chunks were suppressed.
Only hashes, rank buckets, and counts were recorded.
The receipt proves delivery, not answer correctness.

best_practices: Use stable or hashed identifiers instead of raw prompts, paths, schemas, customer data, or tool results.
Record before-and-after buckets, suppression reasons, redaction flags, and rollback outcomes.
State an audit gap that distinguishes proven boundary behavior from unverified semantic quality.
anti_patterns: Do not copy raw prompts, schemas, arguments, results, transcripts, secrets, or customer names into receipts.
Do not treat successful tool execution as proof that the selected tool was relevant.
Do not claim context savings when the receipt lacks before-and-after evidence.

faq.question: What is a context receipt?
faq.answer: It is a small audit record showing what entered, left, or stayed outside an agent context.

faq.question: Does the skill store raw prompts?
faq.answer: No. It directs implementations to use identifiers, hashes, counts, buckets, and explicit redaction flags.

faq.question: Which workflows are covered?
faq.answer: It covers tool discovery, retrieval, skill loading, delegation, usage attribution, pruning, compaction, and rollback.

faq.question: Does a receipt prove output correctness?
faq.answer: No. A receipt proves selected boundary behavior and must state any remaining semantic audit gap.

faq.question: Can receipts measure context savings?
faq.answer: They record token and count buckets, but they do not independently calculate or validate cost reductions.

faq.question: Is receipt generation automatic?
faq.answer: No. Your agent or harness must emit, store, and validate receipts using this guidance.
